task: Fix Write-tool line-count overcounting on trailing newlines by lifting the private countContentLines logic into a shared Utils helper and reusing it in the Claude plugin and the OTLP plugin, plus a secondary empty-content linesAdded fix found in code review.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: Utils file-operations helper, Claude plugin file-operation extractor (claude-file-operation.ts), claude-code-otlp transcript session-signals.ts
component_scope.layers: Service (shared Utils helper), Agent-Tool (Claude plugin), Agent-Tool (OTLP plugin)

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Secondary empty-content linesAdded bug (stayed undefined instead of 0) was not in the original ticket description and was only identified during code review (CR-001/CR-002), requiring a small follow-up fix beyond the initial scope

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: countContentLines is now a single shared helper consumed by two independent agent plugins (Claude live/session-replay path and the claude-code-otlp transcript signals path); a regression here silently skews line-count metrics across both plugins rather than one
technical_risk.mitigation: Logic was centralized in src/utils/file-operations.ts behind a pure, well-named function with direct unit tests (file-operations.test.ts, claude-file-operation.test.ts); no behavior change to unrelated extractFormat/detectLanguage helpers; low-risk, easily reversible metrics-only change

key_reasoning.reason: Touches a shared Utils helper plus two independent Agent-Tool consumers (the Claude plugin's claude-file-operation.ts and the claude-code-otlp plugin's session-signals.ts) that both needed their line-counting call sites updated to delegate to the new countContentLines helper — the 'touches core shared utilities' pattern bumps this from a base M (single-helper, 2-layer coordination) to L.

countContentLines became the single source of truth for line counts consumed by two separate agent plugins; a regression would silently skew metrics in both places at once, though the change itself is additive/well-tested and trivially reversible.

5 files modified (3 source, 2 test), 0 new files, spanning the Utils layer and two distinct agent-plugin directories (claude session and claude-code-otlp transcript) — just above the S band's single-directory ceiling, landing in M.
